plan.name: Systematic Search and Cool
plan.strategy: Perform a systematic search of all potential storage locations for the pot, cool it if necessary, and then place it on the diningtable.
steps: Check the diningtable first to see if the pot is already there (as per E00026).
If not, search countertop 1, sinkbasin 1, and stoveburners (as per E00131).
If the pot is not found there, systematically check all cabinets (from 1 to 10).
If not found in cabinets, check fridge 1 and drawers 1 and 2 (as per E00085).
Once the pot is located, cool it using the fridge or by placing it in the sinkbasin (as per E00067).
After cooling, move the pot to the diningtable 1.
